fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer, set by the function.

fields.name: AmountUsd
fields.description: Credit in USD the coupon grants.

fields.name: PlanKey
fields.description: Optional Plan.Key the coupon puts the organization on.

fields.name: MaxRedemptions
fields.description: How many organizations may redeem it; 0 = no limit.

fields.name: ExpiresAt
fields.description: ISO time after which it cannot be redeemed (empty: never).

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: credit|plan|discount (empty on coupons saved before kinds: credit plus the optional PlanKey).

fields.name: PlanKeys
fields.description: Plans a plan or discount code may be used for (empty: every paid plan).

fields.name: DurationMonths
fields.description: plan: months the code pays; discount: months the discount applies.

fields.name: PerPersonLimit
fields.description: How many times one person may use the code; 0 = no limit.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key, set by the server; unique index.
